skills.description: Share markdown files and text as clean, readable web links via plsreadme.com. Use when someone asks to share a document, README, PRD, proposal, notes, or any markdown as a shareable link. Also triggers for "create a preview link", "share this as a page", or "make this readable". Requires the plsreadme MCP server (npx plsreadme-mcp).
skills.description_zh: 通过 plsreadme.com 将 Markdown 文件和文本分享为简洁可读的网页链接。适用于分享文档、README、PRD、提案、笔记等内容的场景，也响应「创建预览链接」、「分享为页面」或「使其可读」的请求。需配合 plsreadme MCP 服务器使用 (npx plsreadme-mcp)。
skills.name: plsreadme
